prompt: Art classes such as painting or drawing are important for children s development so it should be compulsory in high school.Do you agree or disagree
essay:
In  modern education, all the subjects are equally important for the yonge people , like art and painting, but some of them are not good at that. In this essay, I totally disagree with this statement, which i am going to prove later in this essay.

On the one hand, the art field helps children to develop concentration. This will help them to draw their imagination into the paper and color them to improve their focus as they pay attention to small details while painting. In addition, these lessons may be helpful for them to sharpen their minds , which is good for their curriculum. So many people choose to become painters in their career after learning art in the schools. For Example, to draw a house or a tree, they have to imagine a real house or a tree , which helps them to improve their imagination and make their mind more powerful.

On the other hand, art and painting prevent people from learning other subjects. Firstly, some students do not enjoy painting. Therefore, it may make them less interested in the school. They may prefer to spend more time learning subjects such as math, science , which help them to get job opportunities in the future. Secondly, after attending art classes, they must feel tired as they don't like it. As a result, they can not focus on other educational programmes.

In a nutshell, the art and painting field increases students' focus and patience , but it stops them from learning other important subjects. In this essay i totally disagree that it would be compulsory for young people to learn those subjects.
